note: _dimittesque ante illam velum_ – and shalt let down the veil before it (Douay Version). Since _dimittere_ actually means “to remove,” the correct form should be _demittesque_ (_demittere_ = to let down) as suggested by Valtentin Loch in the preface to his 1849 Vulgate edition (p. viii). This reading is listed in the apparatus of Weber/Gryson. The Nova Vulgata has _abscondes illam velo_ – screen it off with a veil.

Jerome shortens the sentence. Leviticus Text
